// Captured from the unmodified cursor implementation at
// f39243478403695fbd95e68ac83da59f9e021c5b.
package main

import (
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"retrom/internal/foundation/cursor"
)

type filterCapture struct {
	Name    string `json:"name"`
	Encoded string `json:"encoded"`
	Digest  string `json:"digest"`
}

type tokenCapture struct {
	Name        string         `json:"name"`
	NowMS       int64          `json:"nowMs"`
	Input       cursor.Payload `json:"input"`
	PayloadJSON string         `json:"payloadJson"`
	Token       string         `json:"token"`
}

type capture struct {
	SourceHead string          `json:"sourceHead"`
	KeyHex     string          `json:"keyHex"`
	Filters    []filterCapture `json:"filters"`
	Tokens     []tokenCapture  `json:"tokens"`
}

func main() {
	var key [32]byte
	for index := range key {
		key[index] = byte(index)
	}
	const nowMS = int64(1_786_000_000_000)
	codec := cursor.New(key, func() time.Time { return time.UnixMilli(nowMS) })

	filterValues := []struct {
		name  string
		value any
	}{
		{"null", nil},
		{"empty", map[string]any{}},
		{"unicode", map[string]any{"q": "\u96ea"}},
		{"html", map[string]any{"q": "<&>"}},
		{"unicode-html-null", map[string]any{"q": "\u96ea<&>", "tagId": nil}},
	}
	filters := make([]filterCapture, 0, len(filterValues))
	for _, value := range filterValues {
		encoded, err := json.Marshal(value.value)
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		filters = append(filters, filterCapture{
			Name: value.name, Encoded: string(encoded), Digest: cursor.FilterDigest(value.value),
		})
	}

	defaultPayload := cursor.Payload{
		OperationID:  "getGames",
		FilterDigest: filters[4].Digest,
		SortCode:     "TITLE_ASC",
		SortValues:   []string{"\u96ea<&>"},
		ID:           "01980000-0000-7000-8000-000000000001",
	}
	explicitPayload := cursor.Payload{
		OperationID:  "getAdminUsers",
		FilterDigest: filters[1].Digest,
		SortCode:     "CREATED_DESC",
		SortValues:   []string{"1786000000000"},
		ID:           "01980000-0000-7000-8000-000000000002",
		ExpiresAtMS:  nowMS + 1_234_567,
	}
	tokens := []tokenCapture{
		captureToken(codec, "default-expiry", nowMS, defaultPayload),
		captureToken(codec, "explicit-expiry", nowMS, explicitPayload),
	}
	result := capture{
		SourceHead: "f39243478403695fbd95e68ac83da59f9e021c5b",
		KeyHex:     "000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f",
		Filters:    filters,
		Tokens:     tokens,
	}
	encoder := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	encoder.SetEscapeHTML(false)
	encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
	if err := encoder.Encode(result); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

func captureToken(codec *cursor.Codec, name string, nowMS int64, input cursor.Payload) tokenCapture {
	token, err := codec.Encode(input)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	payloadPart, _, _ := strings.Cut(token, ".")
	payloadJSON, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(payloadPart)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return tokenCapture{Name: name, NowMS: nowMS, Input: input, PayloadJSON: string(payloadJSON), Token: token}
}
